metadata.source: Survivor: The Tribe Has Spoken official rules + Survival Guide (67 cards), plus 7 house cards and the Let's Go To Rocks expansion
notes: The official box contains exactly 67 Action Cards. Deck mode 'official' builds from those 67 only.
Idol Nullifier, Steal A Vote, Block A Vote and Grant Immunity (7 cards total) appear nowhere in the official Survival Guide. They are house cards, included only in deck mode 'extended'.
The 5 challenge_* cards are the Orange Challenge Cards from Survivor: Let's Go To Rocks (2025) and are added only when a game is created with expansion=true.
Setup removes the 6 Vote Cards and 9 Tribal Council Cards from the deck: each player is dealt 1 Vote Card and the extras are put away, so no Vote Cards remain in the Draw Pile.

vote.name: Vote
vote.description: Every player gets 1 Vote Card at the start of the game. When voting at Tribal Council you MUST place this card in the Voting Box.

extra_vote.name: Extra Vote
extra_vote.description: When voting at Tribal Council you MAY place this card in the Voting Box as an additional vote (or save it for later).

control_the_vote.name: Control The Vote
control_the_vote.description: Play before voting begins to take any player's Vote Card. You MUST use it in addition to your own Vote Card at this Tribal Council.

goodwill_gamble.name: Goodwill Gamble
goodwill_gamble.description: Give this card to another player before voting begins. It counts as 1 vote and MUST be used at this Tribal Council.

im_the_leader_now.name: I'm The Leader Now
im_the_leader_now.description: Become the Tribal Council Leader immediately

immunity_idol.name: Hidden Immunity Idol
immunity_idol.description: Negate all votes against you at Tribal Council

idol_nullifier.name: Idol Nullifier
idol_nullifier.description: Nullify someone's immunity idol at Tribal Council

steal_vote.name: Steal A Vote
steal_vote.description: Steal another player's vote at Tribal Council - they cannot vote and you vote twice

block_vote.name: Block A Vote
block_vote.description: Prevent another player from voting at this Tribal Council

grant_immunity.name: Grant Immunity
grant_immunity.description: Grant temporary immunity to another player - votes against them do not count

sorry_for_you.name: Sorry For You
sorry_for_you.description: REACTIVE: Play when someone tries to take cards from you - they get nothing and must discard 1 card

the_spy_shack.name: The Spy Shack
the_spy_shack.description: Look at any player's cards and take one.

knowledge_is_power.name: Knowledge Is Power
knowledge_is_power.description: Choose a card type - if target has it, they must give it to you

camp_raid.name: Camp Raid
camp_raid.description: Place face up in front of any player — you take the next card they draw, no matter what it is. You can't play this on a player who already has a Camp Raid in front of them

inheritance.name: Inheritance
inheritance.description: Choose a target player - when they are eliminated, you inherit all their cards

lets_form_an_alliance.name: Let's Form An Alliance
lets_form_an_alliance.description: You and a teammate each steal a card from a victim

reward_challenge_do_or_die.name: Reward Challenge: Do Or Die
reward_challenge_do_or_die.description: Pick any player for a single game of Rock Paper Scissors. Winner steals 2 random cards from the loser; on a tie you each swap 1 card of your choice.

reward_challenge_power_pair.name: Reward Challenge: Power Pair
reward_challenge_power_pair.description: Pick 2 other players. All 3 of you secretly show 1-3 fingers: if exactly 2 match they each steal 1 card from the 3rd, if all match everyone discards 1, if all differ play again.

reward_challenge_its_a_numbers_game.name: Reward Challenge: It's A Numbers Game
reward_challenge_its_a_numbers_game.description: Everyone still in the game secretly shows 1-5 fingers. The lowest UNIQUE number steals 2 random cards from any player. Repeat until there is a single winner.

challenge_highest_bidder.name: Challenge: Highest Bidder
challenge_highest_bidder.description: Start a Challenge. Bid how many rocks you can pull from the bag without pulling the Purple Rock. Winner wears the Immunity Idol Necklace.

challenge_1_now_or_2_later.name: Challenge: 1 Now or 2 Later
challenge_1_now_or_2_later.description: Start a Challenge. Pull 1 rock or pass — but pass and you must pull 2 next time. Pull the Purple Rock and you're knocked out.

challenge_lowest_score_loses.name: Challenge: Lowest Score Loses
challenge_lowest_score_loses.description: Start a Challenge. Secretly pull any number of rocks — grey +1, purple -2. Lowest score each round is knocked out.

challenge_pull_or_steal.name: Challenge: Pull or Steal
challenge_pull_or_steal.description: Start a Challenge. Pull a hidden rock or steal one from a lower-numbered player. Whoever holds the Purple Rock at the reveal wins.

challenge_hide_n_seek.name: Challenge: Hide 'n' Seek
challenge_hide_n_seek.description: NOT AVAILABLE DIGITALLY: this Challenge is physical sleight-of-hand — players palm and bluff-pass rocks while an Observer watches. Discarded with no effect.

vote.name: Vote Cards
vote.description: Vote and Extra Vote cards, spent by placing them in the Voting Box

challenge.name: Challenge Cards
challenge.description: Orange Challenge Cards from Survivor: Let's Go To Rocks (expansion only)
